crew_loft_long_game.label: Put a coin in
crew_loft_long_game.say: You lose a crown to a man with no front teeth, who says thank you every time. Nan laughs.

bazaar_hat_bet.label: Take the bet
bazaar_hat_bet.say: He has an answer for everything, including your sigh. You pay full price in front of the aisle, and the crowd claps him, not you. The hat is magnificent. That makes it worse.

curio.text: The bazaar is all spice-dust in the light, a coat-seller shouting about rain and brass things ticking on velvet, while gulls rattle the glass roof. The curio-seller lifts a hand to you from the end of the aisle, over a cloth with one rare thing on it.

scribeKael.reply: The scribe asks if the North gets letters at all. It does: Kael's answer comes with frost on the envelope and three careful lines, which from Kael is a great deal.
